stages.title: v0.1–v0.3 — Deterministic core & reproducible environment
stages.desc: The simulate-with-models / narrate-with-LLMs core, the knowledge graph, and the environment moving from assumed to stamped and checked.

tasks.title: v0.1 — simulation-driven design review
tasks.aufgabe: Establish the deterministic core (rng, events, ledger, versioning) and the first evidence bundle.
tasks.ziel: A seeded, replayable simulation core with zero LLM calls on the decision path.
tasks.stand: Released 2026-08-02. Bundle archived at evidence/v0.1/20260802T150651+0000 and kept untouched as the comparison baseline.

decisions.text: Architectural rule fixed: the deterministic core decides what happens, the narration layer only verbalises it and never makes a decision.

tasks.title: Knowledge graph + GraphRAG retrieval (build order 2 & 3)
tasks.aufgabe: Load Hetionet via kg_loader, wire graph/client.py, and build the NL->Cypher retriever with allowlist validation.
tasks.ziel: The persona grounds on retrieved subgraph facts with citations instead of drifting.
tasks.stand: Done. Persona-relevant metaedge slice loads 47,031 nodes / 277,997 edges, idempotent on re-run. graph/schema.py is the single source of truth for labels, rel types and metaedge codes.

achievements.text: cypher_guard validates LLM-written Cypher before execution.

decisions.text: Hetionet has only 137 diseases; heart failure is deliberately NOT aliased to a near neighbour — resolve() returns None and the persona grounds on nothing. Grounding on the wrong disease is worse than grounding on none.

tasks.title: Cohort generator + protocol stress-test surface (build order 4 & 5)
tasks.aufgabe: Sample N personas across a subpopulation with copula-coupled trait axes; expose real eligibility evaluation and per-patient burden reporting via the API.
tasks.ziel: Cohort generation and scenario stress-testing usable end to end, offline.
tasks.stand: Done. Build-order items 2–5 are all closed; only ingest/synthea_loader.py remains open.

tasks.title: v0.3 — the environment release
tasks.aufgabe: Declare dependencies in pyproject, resolve with uv.lock, render requirements.txt, enforce sync in CI, close the float-accumulation class, and stamp the environment into every artifact.
tasks.ziel: Every guarantee holds outside the author's machine — environment stamped and checked, not assumed.
tasks.stand: Released 2026-08-14. 859 Python tests across 3.11/3.12/3.13, 27 SPA tests, 3 E2E specs, all green per push.

achievements.text: Four bugs (networkx undeclared, dash venv sourcing, Neumaier sum drift, venv drift) closed as one construction rather than four patches.
CI matrix: Python on 3.11/3.12/3.13, Node once, full leg on the oldest.

validations.text: Guard fires: tests/test_float_accumulation.py walks the core AST and fails on any bare sum() whose operands are not stated. 8 of 10 int-sum markers verify against a schema; the 2 that cannot (Neo4j driver rows) are enumerated by the test rather than remembered.

decisions.text: Environment enforcement in tiers: refuse on lock-hash mismatch, warn on interpreter difference inside the supported range, refuse outside it. The warn tier is only honest while the matrix keeps running goldens on every interpreter.

tasks.title: Prompt v2 re-record
tasks.aufgabe: Re-record the narration battery with exactly one declared variable changed — the prompt — against the same weights, sampling and pre-registered bars.
tasks.ziel: Kill the doubled-citation defect at source rather than in the renderer, and close the model_recall margin.
tasks.stand: Done 2026-08-14 (commit 168a686). A second measurement, not a repair; v0.1's bundle stays untouched as the comparison baseline.

achievements.text: Double-citation dead at source: 0 of 30 raw responses contain an inline [F###] marker (v1: 7 of 25). Renderer stripping stays as defence in depth and now has nothing to strip.
Bundles archive both layers — segments as the model emitted them, plus the rendered text. Dead-and-wrong take-fetching code replaced.

validations.text: model_recall 0.525 against the 0.5 bar on the full battery, up from v1's exactly-on-the-bar 0.500 — two independent readings above the bar.
Friction hypothesis supported but CONFOUNDED: quarantine 5/30 -> 0/30, retries 6.7% -> 0%, but some of that is attributable to a separate finding and the two causes are not yet separated.

stages.title: v0.4 — State-citation (P/B/J/E namespaces)
stages.desc: The active workstream. v2's factual_fraction collapse on burden and mitigation is claimed to be a state-citation gap; the pre-registered shape says what would falsify that.

tasks.title: Pre-register the v3 expected shape + control arm
tasks.aufgabe: Write the expected v3 shape and its falsifier BEFORE the namespaces are built and before any v3 recording.
tasks.ziel: A prediction that is a prediction — committed before the numbers exist, same rule as pass_bars.json.
tasks.stand: Done (1e0ce63), amended to four namespaces (c98cb19). Amendment legitimate only because nothing is recorded yet, and stated rather than slipped in.

decisions.text: The escape clause is a CONTROL ARM, not a ceiling number. Graph-knowledge tags (ae, tx, proc) gained nothing from P/B/E and must stay flat within 0.10. sym is explicitly NOT a control — symptoms are simulated state, so P-citations there are legitimate.

Four namespaces, not three: P- profile, B- derived barriers, J- journey milestones, E- RESERVED for simulation event-log entries. An id namespace whose meaning changes later makes every v3 recording silently ambiguous.

tasks.title: Build the P/B/J/E id namespaces
tasks.aufgabe: Implement the four state-citation namespaces under constrained decoding: P- profile, B- derived barriers, J- journey milestones, E- reserved and empty for unsimulated personas.
tasks.ziel: The persona can cite its own declared state, not only graph knowledge.
tasks.stand: Shape is pre-registered and amended; implementation not started. E- stays empty until simulated personas enter the battery.

tasks.title: Record the v3 battery against the pre-registered bars
tasks.aufgabe: Run the battery with the namespaces live, changing exactly one declared variable, and write the bundle beside v0.1 and v0.3.
tasks.ziel: A third reading comparable to the first two.

tasks.title: Adjudicate: recovery or over-correction?
tasks.aufgabe: Check burden and mitigation factual_fraction against the controls. If burden and mitigation recover while ae/tx/proc hold flat within 0.10, the new ids did the work. If everything rises together it is over-correction, however good the burden numbers look.
tasks.ziel: A verdict the pre-registration can actually adjudicate, not a number chosen after the fact.

stages.title: Grounding in real data
stages.desc: Retire the literature ballparks. The last open build-order item is the gate for everything in this stage.

tasks.title: ingest/synthea_loader.py — real Synthea CSV joins -> PatientDNA
tasks.aufgabe: Join real Synthea CSV exports into the PatientDNA schema. Search TODO(claude-code) markers for the exact insertion points.
tasks.ziel: Persona generation draws on real distributions instead of condition-based priors alone.
tasks.stand: The one open build-order item (items 2–5 are done).

tasks.title: Re-derive epidemiology priors from loaded data
tasks.aufgabe: Replace cohort/epidemiology.py literature ballparks with priors derived from ingested data, and lift the do-not-quote caveat once they are sourced.
tasks.ziel: A number from cohort/epidemiology.py can be quoted as a finding.
tasks.stand: Blocked on synthea_loader. Until then: never quote a number from that module as a finding.

stages.title: Identifiability & product surface
stages.desc: Close the one knowingly unidentifiable parameter, then widen the surface from demo to usable tool.

tasks.title: Third anchor for cumulative_burden_weight
tasks.aufgabe: Design an anchor that varies per-visit burden at a fixed visit count, so cumulative_burden_weight separates from burden_increment_weight.
tasks.ziel: The parameter is estimated rather than frozen at zero.
tasks.stand: Ships frozen at zero — unidentifiable from two anchors. Known and declared, not hidden.

tasks.title: Scenario comparison views + exportable reports
tasks.aufgabe: Add scenario comparison output and exportable reports on top of Scenario Lab, Interview Room and Cohort Studio.
tasks.ziel: A stakeholder can run a comparison and take an artifact away without the author present.

okrs.title: A persona cannot claim anything it cannot cite
okrs.desc: Every statement traces to declared state (P/B/J/E) or retrieved graph knowledge — verified by measurement against pre-registered bars, not by inspection.

krs.text: burden & mitigation factual_fraction recover under P/B/J/E while controls (ae, tx, proc) stay flat within 0.10
Inline [F###] markers in raw responses stay at 0 of 30 (v1: 7 of 25)
model_recall above the 0.5 bar on two independent readings

okrs.title: A result reproduces without the author's machine
okrs.desc: Environment declared, locked, verified across every supported interpreter, and stamped into every artifact that claims reproducibility.

krs.text: Full suite green on 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13 on every push
Every baseline, verdict and bundle stamps python + numpy + lock hash; mismatch refuses
An evidence bundle supports its own reading protocol without external files

okrs.title: Realism comes from data, not from ballparks
okrs.desc: Retire the caveats that currently block quoting the model's own numbers as findings.

krs.text: synthea_loader produces PatientDNA from real Synthea joins (last open build-order item)
A number from cohort/epidemiology.py is quotable as a finding (do-not-quote caveat lifted)
cumulative_burden_weight estimated from a third anchor instead of frozen at zero
